question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.
sql:
-- Final query: Top 3 bowlers by max runs in a single over among max-run overs
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler,
           SUM(COALESCE(bts.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(e.extra_runs, 0)) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bts ON b.match_id = bts.match_id AND b.over_id = bts.over_id AND b.ball_id = bts.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs e ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler
),
max_over_runs AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(total_runs) as max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_overs AS (
    SELECT o.match_id, o.over_id, o.innings_no, o.bowler, o.total_runs
    FROM over_runs o
    JOIN max_over_runs m ON o.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE o.total_runs = m.max_runs
),
bowler_max AS (
    SELECT bowler, MAX(total_runs) as max_runs_in_over
    FROM max_overs
    GROUP BY bowler
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT p.player_name, mo.match_id, bmo.max_runs_in_over as total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY bmo.max_runs_in_over DESC, p.player_name) as rn
    FROM bowler_max bmo
    JOIN max_overs mo ON bmo.bowler = mo.bowler AND bmo.max_runs_in_over = mo.total_runs
    JOIN player p ON mo.bowler = p.player_id
)
SELECT player_name, match_id, total_runs
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY total_runs DESC, player_name
